desc:
🥚 Welcome to Pump an Egg!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from sleeping guardians
🏃 Run back to your base before they catch you!
🎈 Pump your egg to make it HUGE... but don't let it pop!
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare animals
💰 Earn money from your animals
👟 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill, pump and base
🏏 Bonk other players and steal their eggs
✨ Discover giant eggs, rare animals and mutations!
